messages:
Olivia: FYI — customers reported a sudden increase in 400s after the 01:10 canary flip. Root cause looks like fncall validator rejecting responses: `SchemaError: response.items expected object but got []`.
Ben: Wasn't strict-validate supposed to be only 1%? I thought we gated that.
Sam (SRE): Canary toggle was accidentally promoted to 100% during the deploy job. DeployBot: canary/blue applied @01:09 (build 2026.04.05-01:08).
Olivia: Impact: ~0.22% of prod traffic, storage of traces doubled because we capture full payloads for each reject. Customers see 400s — bad UX.
Ben: Immediate mitigation: revert sampling back to 1% and change routing for `prod/*` to permissive-coerce + legacy fallback so callers don't see 400s.
TelemetryBot: note: current metric is `fncall.rejects` (no labels). We need per-route/model labels and a sample example stream. Suggest `fncall.rejects{route,variant,strict=true}` and `fncall.coerced{route,variant}`.
ConsoleTeam: We can add a dashboard tile (fncall/validation) with reject_rate by route, coerced_count, fallback_rate, and a scrubbed example stream. Recommend example sampler 1/1000 and PII scrubber.
Sam (SRE): Also change tracing to sampled captures (1/500) and cap body at 64KB to control storage. Billing note: treat immediate fallback successes (<1s) as non-billable for the original rejected attempt.
Olivia: I'll open rollback PR to restore sampling and patch router fallback. Ben, can you own telemetry + dashboard config?
Ben: On it. PRs: rollback -> "revert/canary-sampling-fix"; telemetry -> "metrics/fncall-validation-tags". I'll add scrub rules: redact emails, mask long digit sequences, drop ssn/dob fields; keep hashed session_id.
ConsoleTeam: ETA 90m for dashboard tiles and example stream. We'll use metric names from TelemetryBot.
Sam (SRE): Rollback merged -> canary sampling back to 1% and fallback enabled. Early check: rejects down to 0.01%, fallback_used 0.14%. Traces reduced.
Olivia: Filed INC-2026-210 (P2) and TASK-622 for model adapter fix. Postmortem owners: Olivia (timeline), Ben (telemetry), Sam (router/billing). Add canary checklist item: sampling verification, fallback, telemetry, scrubber, billing rule.
Ben: Will also add an automated preflight linter to fail deploys where sampling >10% unless explicitly approved.
Olivia: Thanks — closing thread once postmortem is up. :white_check_mark:
